title: OMIverse
tagline: OMIverse turns your spoken memories into NFTs, creating a digital universe of your life's most meaningful moments.
description: OMIverse is a revolutionary platform that transforms your spoken memories into unique digital art, forever preserved on the blockchain. By simply sharing your experiences with OMI, your most precious moments are transformed into AI-generated masterpieces, each tied to the location where the memory was born. Every memory becomes a one-of-a-kind NFT, creating a personal universe of experiences you can revisit, share, and treasure.
how_its_made:
OMIverse is built using a modern stack that combines OMI device, AI, blockchain, and web technologies.
